what: Proposed self-validation is weaker than dispatcher/schema for files_touched element shape
scenario_or_breakage: The jq block accepts files_touched:[{}] because it checks only array length, but dispatcher rejects missing .files_touched[].path and schema documents path/lines_added/lines_removed per object
suggested_fix: Add an all(.files_touched[]; type=="object" and (.path|type=="string") and (.lines_added|type=="number") and (.lines_removed|type=="number")) check, or at minimum mirror the dispatcher's .path string check

what: The proposed grep guard cannot detect schema-template field drift
scenario_or_breakage: A generated implementer prompt can retain "schema_version": "1" and the self-validation heading while the template says summary instead of summary_bullets; test-codex-implementer/test-cursor-implementer and check-generators still pass, and agent-lint has no implementer-manifest structural rule
suggested_fix: Replace the string-presence check with a structural fixture check that extracts the Manifest JSON template and asserts required field names/paths, or compare it against a canonical fixture derived from codex-manifest-schema.md
